title: How to convert PySpark Pandas Dataframe to a PySpark Dataframe?
question:
I have a dataset stored into a pyspark.pandas.frame.DataFrame which I want to convert to a pyspark.sql.DataFrame before saving it to a delta file. Which is the right way to do it?

P.S: The reason for this is because I want to enforce a schema-on-write when saving it to delta. However, PySpark Panda's to_delta method seems not to accept schema parameters .

Thanks in advance
answer: Just putting @Emma's comment under the question as the answer for others. Use df.to_spark()
